static: The Shared Park

One copy for the whole class. No object needed — but no this either.

⏱ 12 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Shared sign, private plots

Litter in the park bothers all.

🌳

Colony park vs gardens. totalBooks: ONE shared sign. title: per-house garden. Anyone strolls into the park (no object!) but sees no private gardens (no this). Shared mutable = shared RISK.

ProgramRead each line in order
class Book {
  static int total = 0; // ONE park sign, shared
  String title;         // per-house garden
  Book(String t) { title = t; total++; }
}
new Book("A");
new Book("B");
System.out.println(Book.total); // prints 2

Two births, one sign ticked twice.

new A
total = 1
Tick
new B
total = 2
Tick again
Constants + pure helpers: ideal. Mutable shared: gloves on.
